Baba Farid University of Health Sciences (BFUHS), Faridkot, handles every step of the MBBS BDS admissions process in Punjab. Your NEET marks determine your eligibility for admission to medical colleges in Punjab.

sections.heading: Punjab MBBS Admission Process
sections.description: Steps for MBBS counseling in Punjab

children.text: Admission Process

1. In Govt. colleges of Punjab, 15% of the MBBS seats are allotted under the All India Quota (AIQ) through MCC Counseling and 85% through the state quota counselling conducted by Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot (BFUHS).
2. In Private Colleges of Punjab, 100% of the MBBS seats are allotted through the Punjab State Quota counselling.
3. AIIMS Bathinda, 100% MBBS seats are allotted through a centralized counseling conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC).
